SMF72RGL.description: Length of resource group data section (subtype 3)

SMF72RGN.description: Number of resource group data sections (subtype 3)

SMF72RTS.description: Offset to response time distribution bucket data section (subtype 3)

SMF72RTL.description: Length of response time distribution bucket data section (subtype 3)

SMF72RTN.description: Number of response time distribution bucket data sections (subtype 3)

SMF72DNS.description: Offset to resource delay names section (subtype 3)

SMF72DNL.description: Length of resource delay names section (subtype 3)

SMF72DNN.description: Number of resource delay names sections (subtype 3)

SMF72M3R.description: Record was written by RMF Monitor III

SMF72RCL.description: SMF record converted to lower service level. Bit is set by SMF record retrieval service GRBSMFR.

SMF72RCH.description: SMF record converted to higher release or service level. Bit is set by SMF record retrieval service GRBSMFR.

SMF72ALTVM.description: Running under an alternate virtual machine environment

SMF72IIP.description: zIIP boost was active during entire interval

SMF72EED.description: Speed boost was active during entire interval

SMF72BOO.description: Boost class is set at end of interval, valid only when zIIP boost and/or Speed boost is active: 001 IPL, 010 Shutdown, 011 Recovery Process

SMF72MVS.description: MVS software level (consists of an acronym and the version, release, and modification level - ZVvvrrmm)

SMF72IML.description: Indicates the type of processor complex on which data measurements were taken. X'03' = 9672, zSeries

SMF72PRI.description: At least one zAAP is currently installed

SMF72PRP.description: At least one zIIP is currently installed

SMF72RAO.description: Offset to reassembly area relative to start of RMF product section

SMF72RAL.description: Length of reassembly area. Area consists of a fixed header and a variable number of information blocks. Length depends on the record type/subtype, but is fixed for a specific type/subtype

SMF72RAN.description: Number of reassembly area. This field is used to indicate whether SMF record is broken. If 0, record is not broken. If 1, record is broken. Offset and length are only valid if SMFxxRAN is 1. Reassembly area is only present in broken records.

SMF72OIL.description: Original interval length as defined in the session or by SMF (in seconds)

SMF72GIE.description: Projected gathering interval end GMT time

SMF72XNM.description: Sysplex name as defined in ECVTSPLX

SMF72SNM.description: System name for current system as defined in CVTSNAME

R723DNST.description: Subsystem type as used in the classification rules specified in the WLM administrative application

R723DNNU.description: Number of the resource delay type. Values 1-15 are related to R723RW01-R723RW15

R723GGPV.description: Specification of R723GGMN and R723GGMX is in percentage of the LPAR share rather than in service units. In addition, the scope of the resource group is system-wide rather than sysplex-wide

R723GGPC.description: Specification of R723GGMN and R723GGMX is in percentage of a single processor capacity rather than in service units. In addition, the scope of the resource group is system-wide rather than sysplex-wide

R723GGMS.description: Specification of R723GGMN and R723GGMX is in MSU/h rather than in service units

R723GISP.description: Specialty processor consumption is included into the WLM capping algorithms, i.e. R723GGMN and R723GGMX limit the combined general purpose and specialty processor consumption

R723GTRG.description: Indicator for a tenant resource group

R723GGMN.description: If R723GMNS is ON, minimum capacity of the resource group. If R723GGPV, R723GGPC and R723GGMS are OFF, this value is in unweighted CPU service units per second. In addition, the scope of the resource group is sysplex-wide. If R723GGPV, R723GGPC or R723GGMS is ON, see description of R723GGLT

R723GGMX.description: If R723GMXS is ON, maximum capacity of the resource group. If R723GGPV, R723GGPC and R723GGMS are OFF, this value is in unweighted CPU service units per second. In addition, the scope of the resource group is sysplex-wide. If R723GGPV, R723GGPC or R723GGMS is ON, see description of R723GGLT

R723GGML.description: If R723GMLS is ON, memory limit of the resource group

R723GGTI.description: Tenant identifier. Only valid if R723GTRG is ON.

R723GGTN.description: Tenant name. Only valid if R723GTRG is ON.

R723GGKY.description: Solution identifier. Only valid if R723GTRG is ON.

additionalProperties.description: Response Time distribution map or counts. Each map entry defines a maximum percentage of the midpoint that was calculated for the response time distribution. When used in conjunction with an entry in the response time distribution count table, it shows the number of transactions that completed in a percentage of the midpoint.

R723TRDB.description: Response Time distribution map or counts. Each map entry defines a maximum percentage of the midpoint that was calculated for the response time distribution. When used in conjunction with an entry in the response time distribution count table, it shows the number of transactions that completed in a percentage of the midpoint.

R723SCSN.description: Name of service class being served

R723SCS#.description: Number of times an AS running with service class R723MCNM served service class R723SCSN

SMF72_SUBTYPE3_SERVICE_CLASS_SERVED_SECT.description: Service classes being served by one or more AS in service class R723MCNM

R723CRTX.description: Index into the response time distribution buckets. Entry 0 represents the distribution map

R723CWMX.description: Index into the work/resource manager states area

R723CWMN.description: Number of entries in the work/resource manager states area associated with this service class period (R723CWMX points to the first entry)

R723CRS1.description: Service and Report class period flags

R723CRPH.description: This report class period is heterogeneous.

R723CCIMP.description: Service class period implicitly designated CPU critical

R723CRCA.description: Resource consumption data actuals (R723CRCD) are available

R723CRTA.description: Response time data actuals (R723CRTD) are available

R723CEDA.description: General execution delay data actuals (R723CGDE) are available

R723CMIL.description: x'80' Response time specified in milliseconds

R723CSEC.description: x'40' Response time specified in seconds

R723CMIN.description: x'20' Response time specified in minutes

R723CHOU.description: x'10' Response time specified in hours

R723CVAL.description: Response time goal - or Execution velocity goal - or zero if discretionary, system or no goal

R723CIMP.description: Relative importance of the goal to be achieved for this service class period (1=highest, 5=lowest)

R723CDUR.description: Service class period duration in service units, or zero for last period

R723CSRV.description: Total service units (floating point 64-bit long format)

R723CCPU.description: Total CPU service units (floating point 64-bit long format)

R723CIOC.description: Total IOC service units (floating point 64-bit long format)

R723CMSO.description: Total storage service units (floating point 64-bit long format)

R723CSRB.description: Total SRB service units (floating point 64-bit long format)

R723CPIR.description: Total page-in count (floating point 64-bit long format)

R723CHPI.description: Total hiperspace page-in count (floating point 64-bit long format)

R723CBPI.description: Total block page-in from aux count (floating point 64-bit long format)

R723CPIE.description: Total page-in from expanded count (floating point 64-bit long format)

R723CBPE.description: Total block page-in from expanded count (floating point 64-bit long format)

R723CBKA.description: Total aux blocks paged in (floating point 64-bit long format)

R723CBKE.description: Total expanded blocks paged in (floating point 64-bit long format)

R723CPRS.description: Total page residency time (1024 microsecond) (floating point 64-bit long format)

R723CERS.description: Total expanded page residency time (1024 microseconds) (floating point 64-bit long format)

R723CTRR.description: Total in storage residency time (1024 microsecond) (floating point 64-bit long format)

R723CTAT.description: Total transaction active time (1024 microsecond) (floating point 64-bit long format)

R723CRCT.description: Total RCT time (microseconds) (floating point 64-bit long format)

R723CIIT.description: Total I/O interrupt time (microsecond) (floating point 64-bit long format)

R723CHST.description: Total hiperspace service time (microseconds) (floating point 64-bit long format)

R723CCRM.description: Total hiperspace eso read miss count

R723CRCP.description: Count of transaction completions for this period. This field includes transaction completions reported by subsystem work managers via the IWMRPT service

R723CARC.description: Count of transaction that completed abnormally as reported by subsystem work manager. This value is not part of R723CRCP and should not be used for response time calculations

R723CNCP.description: Count of transaction that completed their execution phase as reported by subsystem work managers via the IWMNTFY service

R723CANC.description: Count of transaction that completed their execution phase abnormally as reported by subsystem work Manager. This value is not part of R723CNCP and should not be used for execution response time calculations

R723CTET.description: Total transaction elapsed time (1024 microsecond) (floating point 64-bit long format)

R723CXET.description: Total transaction execution time (1024 microseconds) (floating point 64-bit long format)

R723CETS.description: Sum of transaction elapsed times squared (1024 microseconds) (floating point 64-bit long format)

R723CTOT.description: Total delay samples used in SRM's execution velocity calculation

R723CCDE.description: CPU delay. A TCB or SRB is waiting to be dispatched (other than the first in-line behind sampler) or a TCB is waiting for local lock

R723CCCA.description: CPU capping delay. A TCB or SRB is marked non-dispatchable because a resource group maximum is being enforced. Note that R723CCCA is NOT a subset of R723CCDE

R723CSWI.description: Swap-in delay. Swap-in has started, but not completed completed

R723CMPL.description: MPL delay. Ready but swap-in has not started

R723CAXM.description: AUX page from cross memory memory

R723CUNK.description: Unknown. Dispatchable unit or AS is waiting, but none of the above reasons apply. These samples are not included in R723CTOT

R723CIDL.description: Idle. Work is in STIMER wait, TSO terminal wait, APPC wait, or is an initiator waiting for work. These samples are not included in R723CTOT

R723CPDE.description: Resource group capping count. Group maximum is being enforced for work in this service class. These samples are not included in R723CTOT

R723CPQU.description: Quiesce count. Some work in this service class has been reset via the RESET xxx, QUIESCE command. These samples are not included in R723CTOT

R723CSAC.description: Sampled address space count. Number of address spaces that contributed delay and using samples to this service class. These samples are not included in R723CTOT

R723CSRS.description: Total shared page residency time (1024 microseconds) (long floating point)

R723CSPA.description: Total shared page-ins from auxiliary storage (long floating point)

R723CSPE.description: Total shared page-ins from expanded storage (long floating point)

R723CICT.description: Total DASD I/O connect time in 128 microsecond units

R723CIWT.description: Total DASD I/O wait time (queue time + pending time in 128 microsecond units)

R723CIDT.description: Total DASD I/O disconnect time in 128 microsecond units. Does not include IOS queue time.

R723CIRC.description: Total DASD I/O count. This can be used with the above fields (R723CICT, R723CIWT, and R723CIDT) to determine the average DASD resp. time for the period. (long floating point)

R723CTOU.description: Total usings. Velocity should be calculated as R723CTOU/ (R723CTOU+R723CTOT).

R723CIOU.description: Total I/O usings. These are included in R723CTOU. Only non paging DASD I/Os can contribute to I/O usings.

R723CQ.description: Queue delay samples. Work is waiting for a server

R723CSPV.description: Server private area paging delay samples

R723CSVI.description: Server space VIO paging delay samples

R723CNDI.description: Non DASD I/O using or delay samples

R723CTDQ.description: Total delay samples always including batch queue delay. For service classes that contain batch jobs that were not run in WLM managed initiators the batch queue delay samples are derived from the measured batch queue delay time. For service classes that contain jobs that ran in WLM managed initiators this value is the same as RCEATOTD. RCAETOTDQ can be used as a migration aid to determine what a batch service class period's velocity will be if its jobs are run in WLM managed initators

R723CTSA.description: Total execution samples. It is the sum of RCAETOTU, RCAETOTD, RCAEUNKN and RCAEIDLE. Also always includes I/O using/delay samples whether or not I/O samples are included in RCAETOTU or RCAETOTD, respectively. (Long floating point)

R723CIOT.description: Total DASD IOS queue time in 128 microsecond units (long floating point)

R723CQDT.description: Total queue delay time. For batch jobs this is the time jobs spent on the job queue while eligible to run on some system. It represents the time the jobs spent waiting for an initiator. For TSO users, this time can be a portion of the LOGON process. For APPC this is the time an APPC request spends on an APPC queue. (long floating point in 1024 micro second units)

R723CADT.description: Total time batch jobs were ineligible to run because a resource the job had affinity to was unavailable. Only applies to batch work. Zero for other work types. (long floating point in 1024 microsecond units)

R723CCVT.description: Total time batch jobs spent in JCL conversion. Only applies to batch work. Zero for other work types. (long floating point in 1024 microsecond units)

R723CIQT.description: Total time batch jobs spend on job queue (after JCL conversion) while ineligible to run on any system for reasons other than resource affinities. Only applies to batch work. Zero for other work types. (long floating point in 1024 microsecond units)

R723CIEA.description: Independent enclave total transaction active time (in 1024 microsecond units) for enclaves that originated on this system.

R723CXEA.description: Exported enclave total transaction active time (in 1024 microsecond units).

R723CFEA.description: Foreign enclave total transaction active time (in 1024 microsecond units).

R723APU.description: AP crypto using samples. A TCB was found executing on a Cryptographic Assist Processor

R723APD.description: AP crypto delay samples. A TCB was found waiting for a Cryptographic Assist Processor

R723FQD.description: Feature queue delay samples. A TCB was found waiting on a processor feature queue associated with a CPU. Subset of R723CCDE. Note, R723CCUS includes feature queue using samples.

R723PLSC.description: Service class that last contributed to this report class period during this interval. Blank if this is a service class period

R723RCOD.description: Contention delay samples count or work waiting for resources as reported to WLM by a resource manager

R723RCOU.description: Contention using samples count of work holding resources as reported to WLM by a resource manager

R723ECTC.description: CPU time consumed while dispatching priority was temporarily raised by enqueue management because the work held a resource that other work needed (in 1024 microsecond units)

R723IFCU.description: zAAP on CP using samples. These are included in R723CCUS

R723SUCU.description: zIIP on CP using samples. These are included in R723CCUS

R723CSUP.description: Total service units on zIIPs. Multiply with R723NFFS and divide by 256 to calculate the CP equivalent value.

R723CSUC.description: Total service units on CPs spent by zIIP eligible work

R723CIFA.description: Total service units on zAAPs. Multiply with R723NFFI and divide by 256 to calculate the CP equivalent value.

R723CIFC.description: Total service units on CPs spent by zAAP eligible work

R723TPDP.description: CPU time consumed while dispatching priority of work with low importance was temporarily raised to help blocked workloads (in 1024 microsecond units)

R723CPDP.description: CPU time consumed while dispatching priority was temporarily raised by chronic resource contention management because the work held a resource that other work needed (in 1024 microsecond units)

R723LPDP.description: CPU time consumed while dispatching priority was temporarily raised to shorten the lock hold time of a local suspend lock (in 1024 microsecond units).

R723SPDP.description: CPU time consumed while dispatching priority was temporarily raised by z/OS Supervisor to a higher DP than the WLM assigned DP (in 1024 microsecond units)

R723RTDM.description: Midpoint of all response times that were collected in the response time distribution buckets in milliseconds. For response time goals, the mid point is always the response time goal. For execution velocity goals, it is the average of all response times that were collected in the response time distribution buckets. The field equals zero for discretionary goals.

R723RTDC.description: Number of midpoint changes that occurred during interval

R723RTDT.description: Timestamp showing the last time when a midpoint change occurred. The midpoint is kept in R723RTDM.

R723TSUCP.description: Total service units consumed by transactions, executed on on general purpose processors.

R723TSUSP.description: Total service units consumed by transactions, executed on on specialty processors.

R723TSUOCP.description: Total service units consumed by transactions, eligible to run on specialty processors, but executed on general purpose processors.

R723MSUCP.description: Service units consumed by transactions, classified with reporting attribute MOBILE, executed on general purpose processors.

R723MSUSP.description: Service units consumed by transactions, classified with reporting attribute MOBILE, executed on specialty processors.

R723MSUOCP.description: Service units consumed by transactions, classified with reporting attribute MOBILE, eligible to run on specialty processors, but executed on general purpose processors.

R723ASUCP.description: Service units consumed by transactions, classified with reporting attribute CATEGORYA, executed on general purpose processors.

R723ASUSP.description: Service units consumed by transactions, classified with reporting attribute CATEGORYA, executed on specialty processors.

R723ASUOCP.description: Service units consumed by transactions, classified with reporting attribute CATEGORYA, eligible to run on specialty processors, but executed on general purpose processors.

R723BSUCP.description: Service units consumed by transactions, classified with reporting attribute CATEGORYB, executed on general purpose processors.

R723BSUSP.description: Service units consumed by transactions, classified with reporting attribute CATEGORYB, executed on specialty processors.

R723BSUOCP.description: Service units consumed by transactions, classified with reporting attribute CATEGORYB, eligible to run on specialty processors, but executed on general purpose processors.

R723CTETX.description: Total transaction elapsed time. Same as R723CTET, but in microseconds.

R723CXETX.description: Total transaction execution time. Same as R723CXET, but in microseconds.

R723CETSX.description: Sum of transaction elapsed times squared. Same as R723CETS, but in microseconds.

R723CQDTX.description: Total queue delay time. Same as R723CQDT, but in microseconds.

R723CADTX.description: Total time batch jobs were ineligible to run because a resource the job had affinity to was unavailable. Same as R723CADT, but in microseconds.

R723CCVTX.description: Total time batch jobs spent in JCL conversion. Same as R723CCVT, but in microseconds.

R723CIQTX.description: Total time batch jobs spend on job queue (after JCL conversion) while ineligible to run on any system for reasons other than resource affinities. Same as R723CIQT, but in microseconds.

R723ENCTRXNUM.description: Number of single subsystem transactions processed within enclaves.

R723ENCTRXCALLS.description: Number of times transaction data has been reported by subsystem work managers when deleting an enclave.

R723ENCTRXET.description: Total execution time in microseconds for number of subsystem transactions in R723ENCTRXNUM. (format: float)

R723ENCTRXETS.description: Sum of squared execution times in microseconds for number of subsystem transactions in R723ENCTRXNUM. (format: float)

R723MRCL.description: x'80' This is a report class (RCAARCL)

R723MCAA.description: x'40' RCAA data not available RC 08/RSN 0831 from IWMRCOLL

R723MOVE.description: x'10' System is calculating velocity using I/O delays

R723MDAT.description: x'02' Indicator for dynamic alias management

R723MIPG.description: x'01' Indicator for I/O priority group HIGH

R723HISF.description: Failure returned by HISMT service. Multithreading maximum capacity numerator values are invalid.

R723MNHP.description: Indicates ineligibility for honor priority. When ON, specialty engine eligible work in this service class is not offloaded to CPs for help processing

R723MTRC.description: Indicator for a tenant report class

R723MDIS.description: Service class and tenant report class periods that are assoc iated with a resource group and have assigned a discretionary goal are excluded from workload management

R723MBAI.description: WLM batch initiator management is AI infused

R723MAPO.description: At least one zAAP online in sysplex (or local system when not joined to a sysplex)

R723MCPU.description: System pre-set CPU service coefficient (CPU = 1 * 10000). The number by which accumulated CPU service units will be multiplied (weighted)

R723MSRB.description: System pre-set SRB service coefficient (SRB = 1 * 10000). The number by which accumulated SRB service units will be multiplied (weighted)

R723MTVL.description: Current sample interval (in milliseconds). This is the frequency with which WLM samples delays reported in the RCAA

R723MTV#.description: Total number of times WLM sampling code ran. A RMF issuing successive calls to IWMRCOLL should not assume that WLM sampling code ran at the interval specified by R723MTVL between its calls. This field can be used to translate sampled state data into actual percentages of time.

R723MCPG.description: Number of periods belonging to this service or report class

R723MSUB.description: Number of entries belonging to a subsystem. (See R723MSEC for current release value).

R723MADJ.description: Value of RMCTADJC - adjustment factor for CPU rate

R723MTDI.description: Local time/date the service definition was installed

R723MIDU.description: Userid that installed the service definition

R723CLSC.description: Service class that last contributed to this report class. Blank if this is a service class.

R723NFFI.description: Normalization factor for zAAP. Multiply zAAP service times or service units with this value and divide by 256 to calculate the CP equivalent value

R723NFFS.description: Normalization factor for zIIP. Multiply zIIP service units with this value and divide by 256 to calculate the CP equivalent value.

R723NADJ.description: Nominal adjustment factor for CPU rate

R723MCF.description: Multithreading maximum capacity numerator for general purpose processors. Divide this value by 1024 to get the multi threading maximum capacity factor for all general purpose processors that were configured ONLINE for the complete interval.

R723MCFS.description: Multithreading maximum capacity numerator for zIIP. Divide this value by 1024 to get the multithreading maximum capacity factor for all zIIPs that were configured ONLINE for the complete interval. A zero value is reported if no zIIP is currently installed.

R723MCFI.description: Multithreading maximum capacity numerator for zAAP. Divide this value by 1024 to get the multithreading maximum capacity factor for all zAAPs that were configured ONLINE for the complete interval. A zero value is reported if no zAAP is currently installed.

R723CPA_ACTUAL.description: Physical CPU adjustment factor based on Model Capacity Rating

R723RTYP.description: Subsystem type, as used in the classification rules specified in the WLM administrative application. The subsystem's documentation should explain the meaning that the product attributes to the various states

R723RDBE.description: x'80' Represents states sampled in the begin-to-end phase of a transaction

R723REXE.description: x'40' Represents states sampled in the execution phase of a transaction

R723RESS.description: Total number of transaction states sampled in the work phase specified by R723RFLG

R723RACT.description: Total number of active state samples. Active indicates that there is a program executing on behalf of the work request, from the perspective of the work manager. This does not mean that the program is active from the base control program's perspective

R723RRDY.description: Total number of ready state samples. Ready indicates that there is a program ready to execute on behalf of the work request described by the monitoring environment, but the work manager has given priority to another work request

R723RIDL.description: Total number of idle state samples. Idle indicates that no work reques is available to the work manager that is allowed to run.

R723RWLO.description: Total number of waiting for lock state samples

R723RWIO.description: Total number of waiting for I/O state samples. Waiting for I/O indicates that the work manager is waiting for an activity related to an I/O request. This may be an actual I/O operation or some other function associated with the I/O request

R723RWCO.description: Total number of waiting for conversation state samples. Waiting for conversation may have been used in conjunction with the WLM service IWMMSWCH to identify where the recipient of the conversation is located. In this case, only the switched state will be recorded.

R723RWDS.description: Total number of waiting for distributed request state samples. Waiting for distributed request indicates a high level that some function or data must be routed prior to resumption of the work request. This is to be contrasted with waiting for conversation, which is a low level view of the precise resource that is needed. A distributed request could involve waiting on a conversation as part of its processing

R723RWSL.description: Waiting for a session to be established locally, i.e. on the current MVS image

R723RWSN.description: Waiting for a session to be established somewhere in the network

R723RWSS.description: Waiting for a session to be established somewhere in the sysplex

R723RWMS.description: Waiting for unidentified resource, possibly among another more specific category, but which may not be readily determined

R723RSSL.description: State representing transactions for which there are logical continuations on this MVS image. Subsystem work managers might set this state when they function ship a transaction to another component within the same MVS image

R723RSSS.description: State representing transactions for which there are logical continuations on another MVS image in the sysplex. Subsystem work managers might set this state when they function ship a transaction to another component on another MVS image within the sysplex

R723RSSN.description: State representing transactions for which there are logical continuations somewhere within the network. Subsystem work managers might set this state when they function ship a transaction to another component within the network

R723RWST.description: Total number of waiting for SSL thread samples

R723RWRT.description: Total number of waiting for regular thread samples

R723RWWR.description: Total number of waiting for work table registration samples

R723RAPP.description: Total number of active application state samples

R723RWNL.description: Total number of state samples reflecting waiting for new latch

R723RBPM.description: Number of state samples representing buffer pool misses that resulted in I/O

R723RDNX.description: Index into the resource delay names table

R723RDNN.description: Number of entries in the resource delay names table

SMF72LEN.description: SMF RECORD LENGTH. ZERO AFTER GRBSMFR REASSEMBLY

SMF72TRN.description: NUMBER OF TRIPLETS IN THIS REC

SMF72CPS.description: Offset to service class period data sections (subtype4)

SMF72CPL.description: Length of service class period data sections (subtype4)

SMF72CPN.description: Number of service class period data sections (subtype4)

SMF72SPS.description: Offset to swap reason data sections (subtype 4)

SMF72SPL.description: Length of swap reason data sections (subtype 4)

SMF72SPN.description: Number of swap reason data sections (subtype 4)

SMF72M3R.description: Record was written by RMF Monitor III

SMF72RCL.description: SMF record converted to lower service level. Bit is set by SMF record retrieval service GRBSMFR.

SMF72RCH.description: SMF record converted to higher release or service level. Bit is set by SMF record retrieval service GRBSMFR.

SMF72ALTVM.description: Running under an alternate virtual machine environment

SMF72IIP.description: zIIP boost was active during entire interval

SMF72EED.description: Speed boost was active during entire interval

SMF72BOO.description: Boost class is set at end of interval, valid only when zIIP boost and/or Speed boost is active: 001 IPL, 010 Shutdown, 011 Recovery Process

SMF72MVS.description: MVS software level (consists of an acronym and the version, release, and modification level - ZVvvrrmm)

SMF72IML.description: Indicates the type of processor complex on which data measurements were taken. X'03' = 9672, zSeries

SMF72PRI.description: At least one zAAP is currently installed

SMF72PRP.description: At least one zIIP is currently installed

SMF72RAO.description: Offset to reassembly area relative to start of RMF product section

SMF72RAL.description: Length of reassembly area. Area consists of a fixed header and a variable number of information blocks. Length depends on the record type/subtype, but is fixed for a specific type/subtype

SMF72RAN.description: Number of reassembly area. This field is used to indicate whether SMF record is broken. If 0, record is not broken. If 1, record is broken. Offset and length are only valid if SMFxxRAN is 1. Reassembly area is only present in broken records.

SMF72OIL.description: Original interval length as defined in the session or by SMF (in seconds)

SMF72GIE.description: Projected gathering interval end GMT time

SMF72XNM.description: Sysplex name as defined in ECVTSPLX

SMF72SNM.description: System name for current system as defined in CVTSNAME

R724PTM.description: Time policy was activated (Format: STORE CLOCK Unit: local time)

SMF99_RQDATA_MANAGED.description: Work queue is managed on this system

SMF99_RQDATA_ACTIVE_SERVERS.description: 10-second average number of active servers scaled by * 16

SMF99_RQDATA_TOTAL_SERVERS.description: 10-second average total servers. Includes active and idle servers.

SMF99_RQDATA_AVG_TOTAL_REQ.description: Average total requests for the queue eligible to run on the system respresented by this RQDATA entry. This corresponds to the last point plotted on the queue delay plot. Scaled by * 16.

SMF99_RQDATA_#_SERVERS.description: Number of servers required for receiver value

SMF99_RQDATA_PI_DELTA.description: PI delta for donor period of highest importance if servers are started

SMF99_RQDATA_HIGHEST_IMP.description: Highest importance of donor periods negatively affected if servers are started

SMF99_RQDATA_WAITING_FOR_SYSNAME.description: System name sender is deferring to. Blank if deferring only to collect data from other systems.

SMF99_RQDATA_DONOR_CLASS.description: Class name for donor period most impacted by starting servers

SMF99_RQDATA_PER#.description: Period number with in class of donor

SMF99_RQDATA_DONOR_RGROUP.description: resource group name for donor period most impacted by starting servers

SMF99_RQDATA_Q_SKIP_REASON.description: reason defer processing skip clock was set

SMF99_RQDATA_AVG_QUEUED_REQUESTS.description: average number of queued requests over a policy interval scaled by * 16

SMF99_RQDATA_AVG_INELIGIBLE_REQUESTS.description: average number of ineligible queued requests over a policy interval scaled by * 16

SMF99_RQDATA_AVG_CONSTRAINT_REQUESTS.description: average number of queued requests with affinity to constraint systems only scaled by * 16

SMF99POF.description: Offset to the product section from the beginning of the record (including RDW)

SMF99DOF.description: Offset to the data section from the beginning of the record (including RDW)

SMF99_SERVER_OBS.description: Percentage of time this server was serving the period

SMF99_SDATA_WQDEL.description: Delay samples waiting on WLM-managed work queue

SMF99_SDATA_ENC_AUXP.description: aux private paging delay samples experienced by enclave work units known to be associated with an address space

SMF99_SDATA_ENC_VIO.description: aux VIO paging delay samples experienced by enclave work units known to be associated with an address space

SMF99_SDATA_ENC_HSP.description: aux standard hiperspace paging delay samples experienced by enclave work units known to be associated with an address space

SMF99_SDATA_ENC_MPLD.description: MPL delay samples experienced by enclave work units known to be associated with an address space

SMF99_SDATA_ENC_ASWP.description: aux swap delay samples experienced by enclave work units known to be associated with an address space

SMF99_SDATA_SERVER_CLASS_NAME.description: class name of disp serving this period or blank for batch

SMF99_SDATA_ENC_OR_Q_SERVER.description: Server is an enclave or queue server

SMF99_SDATA_BATCH.description: Server is a batch work queue

SMF99_SDATA_SUBSYS_TYPE.description: Subsystem type of owner of the queue. Only applies to batch queue servers.

SMF99_SDATA_SUBSYS_NAME.description: Subsystem name of owner of the queue. Only applies to batch queue servers.

SMF99LEN.description: Record Length. This field and the next field (total of four bytes) form the RDW (record descriptor word).

SMF99FLG.description: System indicator: Bit 0 reserved, Bit 1 subtypes utilized, Bit 2 reserved, Bits 3-6 version indicators, Bit 7 reserved

SMF99TME.description: Time since midnight, in hundreths of a second, that the record was moved into the SMF buffer

SMF99DTE.description: Date when the record was moved into the SMF buffer, in the form 0cyydddF.

SMF996CPOF.description: Offset to service class period section from beginning of record (including RDW)

SMF996CPLN.description: Length of a service class period section

SMF996CPON.description: Number of service class period sections

SMF996_ECLASS_NAME.description: External class name. For an externally defined service class this is the name defined in the service definition. For a server period this name will be of the form $SRMSxxx. For system service classes this name will be $SRMBEST, $SRMDUMP, $SRMGOOD, $SRMDISC, or $SRMQSC.

SMF996_GOALTYPE.description: goal type: 0 - System, SYSSTC, or server goal, 1 - short response time, 2 - long response time, 3 - velocity, 4 - discretionary

SMF996_PERCENTILE.description: Response time goal percentile. Zero if period does not a percentile response time goal.

SMF996_ICLASS_NAME.description: Internal service class name. Same as SMF996_ECLASS_NAME except for discretionary periods. For discretionary periods the name will be of the form $SRMDIxx.

SMF996_GOALVAL.description: goal value: response time goal - goal in milliseconds, velocity - velocity, discretionary, system goal or server period - zero

SMF996_DP.description: Dispatching priority of period for next policy interval

SMF996_IODP.description: I/O priority of period for next policy interval

SMF996_MPLI.description: MPL in-target for next policy interval

SMF996_MPLO.description: MPL out-target for next policy interval

SMF996_RUA.description: Average number of ready address spaces over last policy interval. Scaled by * 16

SMF996_PSPT.description: Time swapped out address spaces in period are protected from being swapped to aux for next policy interval. In 1.024 milliseconds.

SMF996_PSITAR.description: storage isolation target for next policy interval for each address space in period, valid only for work with short response time goals, zero otherwise. Frame count.

SMF996_SERVER_DATA_OF.description: Offset to server section from beginning of record (including RDW). Only valid if period is a server period. There will be one server section entry for each different external service class that server address spaces in this server period were originally classified to.

SMF996_SERVER_DATA_LN.description: LENGTH OF EACH SERVER SECTION ENTRY

SMF996_TIME_AT_PDP_USING.description: Time at PDP (promoted dispatch priority) using samples

SMF996_TIME_AT_PDP.description: Time at PDP (promoted dispatch priority) accumulator

SMF996_EWLM_MANAGED.description: Period is managed using EWLM performance data.

SMF996_IO_PRIORITY_GROUP.description: Period belongs to a service class that was assigned to I/O priority group

SMF996_INELIGHONORPRIORITY.description: Specialty engine work in this period is ineligible for "Honor Priority Processing", i.e. it will not be offloaded to CPs for help processing.

SMF99VN2.description: Record sub version. Used to identify changes to the record in the service stream

SMF99SLV.description: System level from which record was cut (copied from CVTPRODN)

SMF99SNM.description: System name from which record was cut (copied from CVTSNAME)

SMF99_RECORD_INCOMPLETE.description: Only a subset of the available data was written to avoid that this record gets larger than 32 kByte

SMF99_REASM_INDICATOR.description: Only a subset of the available data is written to this record. The rest follows in subsequent records. This record contains a reassembly area.

SMF99POF.description: Offset to the product section from the beginning of the record (including RDW)

SMF99DOF.description: Offset to the data section from the beginning of the record (including RDW)

SMF99_S6_SERVER_CLASS_NAME.description: NAME OF SERVICE CLASS THAT AT LEAST ONE OF THE SERVER ADDRESS SPACES IN THE SERVER PERIOD REPRESENTED BY THE SUBTYPE 6 ENTRY WAS ORIGINAL CLASSIFIED TO

datasetCreationDate.description: The creation date of the SMF data source that was extracted during the SMF discovery

discoveryTimestamp.description: The timestamp when the discovery of the SMF data happened

estimatedByteSize.description: Approximate byte-size of all the SMF data

totalNumberOfRecords.description: Total number of records in the SMF data (each chunked record is calculated)

items.description: A collection of the SMF IDs that are described in the SMF data

earliestSmfRecordMoveTime.description: The earliest timestamp when the record of the SMF data was moved into the SMF buffer (based on the SMF header information)

latestSmfRecordMoveTime.description: The latest timestamp when the record of the SMF data was moved into the SMF buffer (based on the SMF header)

earliestStartOfSmfInterval.description: The earliest timestamp when the measurement interval started for the SMF data. Available for the records of those vendors that are explicitly providing this information

latestStartOfSmfInterval.description: The latest timestamp when the measurement interval started for the SMF data. Available for the records of those vendors that are explicitly providing this information

earliestEndOfSmfInterval.description: The earliest timestamp when the measurement ended for the SMF data (based on the information of start and duration). Available for the records of those vendors that are explicitly providing this information

latestEndOfSmfInterval.description: The latest timestamp when the measurement ended for the SMF data (based on the information of start and duration). Available for the records of those vendors that are explicitly providing this information

smfGroups.description: Description of all the SMF records that belong to the same sub-type; for types without subtype - for records that belong to the same type

SmfDataDescription.description: Description of the SMF records in the SMF data source

estimatedByteSize.description: Estimated byte-size of the SMF group

totalNumberOfRecords.description: Total number of records in the group (each chunked record is calculated)

items.description: A collection of the SMF IDs that are described in the SMF data for this SMF group

earliestSmfRecordMoveTime.description: The earliest timestamp when the record of this group was moved into the SMF buffer (based on the SMF header)

latestSmfRecordMoveTime.description: The latest timestamp when the record of this group was moved into the SMF buffer (based on the SMF header)

earliestStartOfSmfInterval.description: The earliest timestamp when the measurement interval started for this group. Available for the records of those vendors that are explicitly providing this information

latestStartOfSmfInterval.description: The latest timestamp when the measurement interval started for this group. Available for the records of those vendors that are explicitly providing this information

earliestEndOfSmfInterval.description: The earliest timestamp when the measurement ended for this group (based on the information of start and duration). Available for the records of those vendors that are explicitly providing this information

latestEndOfSmfInterval.description: The latest timestamp when the measurement ended for this group (based on the information of start and duration). Available for the records of those vendors that are explicitly providing this information

SmfGroup.description: Description of all the SMF records that belong to the same sub-type; for types without subtype - for records that belong to the same type

Basic.description: Base64 encoding of ID and password joined by a single colon (':')
